stem.text: A bar vibrates with frequency $f$ to produce water waves in a ripple tank.

stem.alt: Diagram of a vibrating bar producing straight water wavefronts that pass through a barrier with a gap, with circular wavefronts spreading beyond the gap. Labels: bar vibrating with frequency f; barrier with gap of width x.

stem.text: The waves pass through a gap of width $x$ in a barrier so that diffraction occurs.
Which combination of vibration frequency and gap width will produce the smallest angle of diffraction?
